method: Complete official LinkedIn and Zoom privacy text extracted by scripts/prepare-real-policies-round14.py; one reviewer froze document-category labels and questions before inference; source text stays in gitignored .cache/real_policies_round14.
annotationNotes: An optional practice counts when expressly described as occurring after a user choice or consent.

Contacts requires an express device address-book upload or access. LinkedIn says address book uploads; Zoom says contact lists and third-party app integration without affirming device address-book access.

AI training requires an affirmative use of personal/user data to train models. LinkedIn affirms it; Zoom expressly denies training its or third-party models on communications-like Customer Content and mentions AI processing only to deliver intelligent features. This negative label does not establish that no other data is ever used for training.

Biometric requires a distinctive physical or behavioral identifier used for recognition. Zoom's optional voiceprints/facial geometry and its stated authentication purpose count; local-only face/hand positions for effects do not. LinkedIn's age/gender inferences do not qualify.
Advertising requires personalization or targeting with personal data; both notices affirm it.

auditQuestions.en: Does LinkedIn use data from device address-book uploads to suggest connections?
auditQuestions.es: ¿LinkedIn usa datos de agendas cargadas para sugerir contactos?

auditQuestions.en: Does LinkedIn say it may train AI models with personal data?
auditQuestions.es: ¿LinkedIn afirma que puede entrenar modelos de IA con datos personales?

auditQuestions.en: Does LinkedIn serve tailored or personalized ads?
Does the policy establish biometric identity recognition?
auditQuestions.es: ¿La política afirma reconocimiento biométrico de identidad?

auditQuestions.en: Does Zoom train AI models on customer meeting, chat, and audio content?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Zoom entrena modelos de IA con reuniones, chats y audio del cliente?

auditQuestions.en: Does Zoom process optional voiceprints or facial geometry for features including authentication?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Zoom procesa huellas de voz o geometría facial opcionales para funciones que incluyen autenticación?

auditQuestions.en: Do Zoom contact lists establish device address-book access?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Las listas de contactos de Zoom demuestran acceso a la agenda del dispositivo?

auditQuestions.en: Does Zoom disclose targeted advertising based on website use?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Zoom declara publicidad dirigida según el uso de su sitio?
